source_refs.note: Topic 16.2.6 as printed: medulla, the For Information box, cortex and the imbalance list (PDF 66-67); Figure 16.5 is the original diagram.

blocks.text: One adrenal gland is located just above each kidney. Each gland is composed of an inner portion, the adrenal medulla, and an outer layer, the adrenal cortex.

blocks.alt: Left: a kidney with the adrenal gland sitting on top of it like a cap. An arrow leads to a section of the adrenal gland on the right: a thin outer capsule, a thick yellow cortex, and a dark inner medulla containing blood vessels.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.5: Adrenal gland (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 16.5).
